detail:
Simultaneous action: "while doing".

Main action comes after ながら.

> Example: 食べながらテレビを見る = Watch TV while eating

Conditional: "if/when". Past tense + ら.

> Example: 雨が降ったら、家にいます = If it rains, I'll stay home

Expresses opinion: "I think that".

> Example: 日本はきれいだと思います

Potential: "can do / be able to".

Also "できる" as "to be made/completed".

> Example: 日本語ができますか = Can you speak Japanese?

Progressive/state: action in progress or resulting state.

> Example: 雨が降っている = It is raining

Excessive: "too much".

Attach to verb stem or remove い from い-adjective.

> Example: 食べすぎた = I ate too much

Obligation: "must do". Double negative = strong obligation.

> Example: 勉強しなければなりません = I must study
